title: Steel Saw
body:
"Flawlessly removes bark off logs, NOTE: LOGS MAY HAVE TO BE CUT UP"

Description

Steel Saw is a saw sold at The Oak Depot for $2000. Despite not having a "Tall" prefix in it's name, it's still a part the "Steel" tier of tools.

Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price. Essentially, Steel Saw is a worse handheld version of Metal Sander.

Appearance

Steel Saw, like the name implies, is a typical saw made out of steel.

It's handle is made out of brown yellowish wood, using the default legacy wood material. It's blade is colored dark gray, with default legacy metal material applied to it.
